sources.title: Visa Exemptions For Non Citizen
sources.officialityEvidence: The live UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs page publishes the current searchable nationality schedule for visa-free and visa-required entry.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa information to enter the country.

unresolved.reason: The current UAE MOFA nationality schedule names the PRC, Hong Kong SAR and Macao SAR, but contains no Taiwan entry. A generic tourist-visa process cannot establish that a Taiwan ordinary passport is accepted, what route applies, or whether a document-recognition restriction exists. No nationality-specific UAE primary source opened in this review resolves the row, so the eVisa fallback is not promoted.
